MAX_AGE_DAYS = 90

SECRETS = [
    ("db-prod-password", 120),
    ("api-key-stripe", 45),
    ("service-account-token", 90),
]

def needs_rotation(age_days, max_age):
    return age_days >= max_age

def audit(secrets, max_age):
    return [
        (name, age, "ROTATE" if needs_rotation(age, max_age) else "OK")
        for name, age in secrets
    ]

results = audit(SECRETS, MAX_AGE_DAYS)
for name, age, status in results:
    print(f"{name} age={age} -> {status}")
count = sum(1 for _, _, status in results if status == "ROTATE")
print(f"rotation_needed={count}")
